👋 Hi! Thank you for contributing to the vLLM project.
 Just a reminder: PRs would not trigger full CI run by default. Instead, it would only run `fastcheck` CI which starts running only a small and essential subset of CI tests to quickly catch errors. You can run other CI tests on top of those by going to your `fastcheck` build on Buildkite UI (linked in the PR checks section) and unblock them. If you do not have permission to unblock, ping `simon-mo` or `khluu` to add you in our Buildkite org. 

Once the PR is approved and ready to go, your PR reviewer(s) can run CI to test the changes comprehensively before merging.

 To run CI, PR reviewers can do one of these:
- Add `ready` label to the PR
- Enable auto-merge.

This PR is ready for review.  A few notes:
1. In order to run this model, we need a new release from `transformers` for reusing HF input processor, so for now this model will only work with `pip install git+https://github.com/huggingface/transformers`. I've added a note about this in the doc.
2. I've verified that inputting `fps` indeed changes `second_per_grid_ts`, so the input processing should be aligned with Huggingface. cc @ShuaiBai623
3. I've removed embeddings as input for the ease of reviewing processes, but it should be easy to add them back based on Qwen2-VL impl. Will leave this work to a future PR. cc @imkero
4. Since this PR was iterated based on Qwen2-VL, I'm not sure if LoRA will work out of box either. cc @jeejeelee
Almost forgot - can you add this model to `tests/models/multimodal/processing/test_common.py` as well?
I have updated it for you.

QQ: Can we use custom RMSNorm ops?
Get it.  Perhaps we could add comments  like mllama does, https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/model_executor/models/mllama.py#L771.

It looks like this MLP is same as  https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/model_executor/models/qwen2.py#L64. Can we implement it like qwen2 did? This implementation would help with LoRA support for vision models, even though we don't currently support LoRA for vision models.

@jeejeelee On a second thought, I think it's probably better if we leave it like this for now because the VisionMLP can take [any activation function specified by the config](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct/blob/main/config.json#L33) from `_ACTIVATION_REGISTRY` whereas we don't have the same support parity in `_ACTIVATION_AND_MUL_REGISTRY`.

What do you think?
